Six completed studies: statistical supplement

Retrospective, exploratory analysis. Principal tests use paired case-family blocks; rounds and prediction components are not independent samples. P-values are two-sided reference tests under the assumptions in STATISTICAL_METHODS.md. Raw, global Holm and study Holm p-values are distinct. Intervals are pointwise, and constant boundary data can produce degenerate intervals. Pilot model-panel tests are separately labeled.

A joint impact-1/counterfactual-no report is not private mechanism knowledge. An uncertain prediction is not an explicit mismatch. Read the generated Markdown guide for source hashes, caveats and reproduction commands. Click a column heading to sort.
